title: Nice concept, TOO many notifications + suggestion for the Make Me Fabulous Feature.
body:
1. It’s jarring and annoying that the app has 6 notifications that show up as 6 on the app badge! Then when I click into the app, it’s not even clear what 6 things needed my attention. This happens every single day. It makes no sense. I really dislike this enough to turn off badge notifications, but I’m worried it’ll affect my returning to the app without a badge reminder.  

2. I love this Make Me Fab feature. I think you should add the ability for people to skip ahead to specific locations esp with bedtime stories. I exited the app and when I returned I found I couldn’t go back to my spot in the story and had to replay from the start.

Thanks!
